card.name: Outpatient and ambulatory care wording
card.fires_on: The word ambulatory (often cut after 'amb'), outpatient, or day when it names care given without an overnight stay, such as same-day surgery or outpatient use of a drug.

modes.label: Ambulatory
modes.description: The ending of the word ambulatory after 'amb', meaning patients who can walk and are not admitted.
modes.example: Amb<<ulatory>> patients may need a slower schedule.

modes.label: Outpatient / day
modes.description: The word outpatient or day in phrases for same-day or non-hospital care.
